title: Ids that keep counting
description:
Every object the game creates needs a unique id. Write `nextEntityId()`, which returns 1 the first time it is called, then 2, then 3, and so on, for the whole run of the program.

Do not use a global variable: keep the counter inside the function, in static storage. The starter is almost right, but it returns 1 every time.
hints: The starter's `counter` is a normal local: a new one is made, set to 0, on every call.
One keyword changes where `counter` lives and how often it is initialised.
rules: Keep the counter in a static local, so it lives for the whole program.
lessonTitle: Static Storage and the Layout of a Program in Memory

rules.message: Keep the counter in a static local, so it lives for the whole program.
